intelligence.essence: One evening of Shawn's eye set the bar for every visible thing: the Personal bar tiles are the model, harvested verbatim, the feed pills are already the standard — and extraordinary is not the exception anywhere. It is the bar for every icon, pill, profile, and post, and the whole system breathes.
intelligence.human_view: The best-looking pieces you already approved become the mold for everything else: the same beautiful tiles everywhere, light that circles an icon when you hover instead of washing over it, a purple heart as the signature you recognize, and pages that feel gently alive rather than frozen.
intelligence.child_view: When we find the prettiest building block, we don't draw a new one for every toy — we use that exact block everywhere, so everything matches and everything is beautiful. And the heart that means love here is purple, like a jewel, not red like everyone else's.
intelligence.grandma_view: He showed us the tiles he loved and said: these, exactly these, everywhere. No redrawing, no close-enough copies. The same care goes to the little things — the pills on the feed were already perfect, so we keep them just as they are — and the whole place should feel like it breathes, slowly and calmly.
intelligence.ai_view: Operating rules distilled from SN-3185..SN-3194: (1) The Personal whole-page bottom-bar tiles are the one icon set, harvested byte-for-byte for Dashboard, Hub, Personal, everywhere. (2) Hover: light goes around the icon only — the moving orbit light returns — never glow over or in the middle. (3) The menu control is a toggle with three states — sidebar OR messenger OR neither, never both. (4) The Intelligent Block is the universal posting format for all images, posts, intelligence, in every feed; renovate to ultimate without wrecking its great parts. (5) LOVE's heart is a purple jewel heart — the network's signature; the red heart is superseded. (6) Every icon everywhere is extraordinary: real, raised, deep, crisp at any zoom. (7) The system breathes: slow gentle motion, alive on hover, press in/out — living intelligence. (8) The feed pills (COLLECTIVE/PERSONAL/ACTIVITY) are triple-A plus — keep verbatim as the standard. (9) Zero gray flat icons anywhere; a checker names every survivor. (10) The connection profile is a full elite page, not a popup.
intelligence.what_it_means: Quality multiplies by copying the proven, not by inventing per page: one harvested set, one posting format, one signature — and the standard applies to the smallest pill with the same force as the largest page.

page.machine: 1) Icon set = Personal bar tiles, verbatim, everywhere. 2) Hover light: around only; orbit light restored. 3) Toggle states: sidebar XOR messenger XOR neither. 4) Posting format: the Intelligent Block, universal. 5) Signature: purple jewel heart. 6) Bar: extraordinary for every icon; pills kept verbatim; zero gray-flat survivors.
page.why_it_matters: This group is the harvest doctrine applied to design: the network stops paying the redesign cost on every page, and a citizen moving between apps meets one familiar, beautiful set of objects — recognition itself becomes a feature.
page.how_it_connects: Second movement of batch 14 (SN-3175–SN-3274). It builds on SN-4737's surface contract — once the face is clean, this group sets what the face is made of — and it is the standard the Inspector sweeps in SN-4744 enforce.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: Everywhere you go in your world, the same beautiful objects greet you — nothing to relearn, nothing jarringly different, and a purple heart you'll know on sight.
page.the_learning: From now on, when a surface passes his eye it becomes the mold — harvested byte-for-byte and held against all others — instead of each lane redesigning from its own taste.
